author: marlon-chaviano
name: api-fastify
title: API with Fastify
description: A Fastify API in TypeScript generated with its official CLI: plugins, folder-based routes with autoload, schema validation and tests.
instructions:
## How to work here

- Routes go in `src/routes/` (the folder is the URL prefix) and shared functionality in `src/plugins/`; both are loaded automatically by `@fastify/autoload`.
- Declare each route's schema (`body`, `querystring`, `response`): Fastify validates the input and serializes the output with it.
- Before finishing: `npm run build:ts && npm test`.
